expected.subject: tamr_client.*
expected.justification: ADR-0009 mandates putting types into the _types module and having 'all function modules depend on the _types module to define their inputs and outputs'; e.g. tamr_client/project.py imports Project, Session, Instance, and URL from tamr_client._types, and every tamr_client function module (dataset, attribute, operation, session, backup, etc.) follows the same pattern
